svg.title: Awesome AI Game Maker — animated parallax poster
svg.desc: A robot game-maker stands in a neon workshop beside a floating holographic game diorama, a cluster of controllers, dice, and pixel blocks, and the title Awesome AI Game Maker. Seven independent depth layers. Move the pointer for parallax; the exported SVG autoplays and the preview adds pause and layer controls.
